title: Please fix the task list 🙏
body: To make the app even more convenient and enjoyable to use, please add the ability to rank tasks for the day. This would allow us to swap them around and manually drag those that need to be done first to the top of the list, while moving less important ones down. This would further simplify working with daily tasks and help visualize the order and sequence of actions. Until you have this feature, I have to create my task lists in another app 😕
author: Ketrin_smile1989
